acceptanceCriteria.drivingSkill: none: legion-smoke ships no domain skill for editing a README; the change is a plain text-file edit verified by reading the file.
acceptanceCriteria.proofCommand: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && tail -n1 README.md   # expect exactly: Stage 3 smoke proof: Legion workflow verified.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: The rendered README.md file on the default branch (GitHub file view / local file read).
acceptanceCriteria.text: A person viewing README.md on the default branch sees a new final line reading 'Stage 3 smoke proof: Legion workflow verified.'

files.change: Append one line 'Stage 3 smoke proof: Legion workflow verified.' as the new last line. Preserve existing lines 1-9 verbatim. If README.md were absent, create it containing only the marker line (Errors clause of the spec); if the marker is already the last line, make no change and report the acceptance already satisfied.

nonGoals: No changes to smoke/, .github/workflows/, or any source/config file.
No new files (the 'add a new file' alternative was rejected in the spec).
ordering: 1. Confirm README.md current tail is line 9 'Legion Stage 3 smoke marker.' and the marker is not already present.
2. Append the marker line as the final line of README.md.
3. Verify tail -n1 README.md equals the marker exactly.

implement: none: reviewed the system-prompt <skills> list (dispatch, envoy, legion-*); none governs appending a line to a README in legion-smoke. The task is a plain text edit with no domain surface, CLI, TUI, or workflow of its own.
review: none: reviewed the <skills> list for a review skill scoped to this repository; the change is a one-line documentation edit reviewed by inspecting the diff. No domain review skill applies.
test: none: reviewed the <skills> list for a smoke/e2e/test skill applicable to a README edit; the only verification is reading the file's last line, which no repository skill governs. legion-smoke has no test harness beyond CI staying green.

reviewEvidence.required: Diff shows exactly one file (README.md) changed, adding exactly one line equal to the marker with no other hunks; existing lines 1-9 unchanged.

risks: Accidentally editing a line other than the final one, or introducing a trailing-newline discrepancy. Mitigated by verifying tail -n1 matches the marker exactly and the diff is a single added line.
summary: Append the single marker line 'Stage 3 smoke proof: Legion workflow verified.' to the end of README.md at the repository root. Exactly one file changes; no source, config, or CI workflow files are touched.

testEvidence.required: Read README.md on the branch head after the append; confirm the marker line is the exact last line. Negative control: an unmodified README.md tail (line 9) does not match the marker, so a missing append is detectable.
testEvidence.surface: File content of README.md on the pushed issue branch / default branch after merge.
